Water_Tank.label: Water Tank
Water_Tank.description: This object provides site specific configuration for devices operating in a water tank.

Valve_Type.label: Valve Type
Valve_Type.description:
The type of discharge valve used:
1. Valve Type 1 - Battery powered pump with feedback
2. Valve Type 2 - Mains powered pump with feedback
3. Valve Type 3 - Mains powered pump without feedback

Sensor_Offset.label: Sensor Offset
Sensor_Offset.description: Distance from the sensor face to the bottom of the tank measured in metres

Tank_Cross_Section.label: Tank Cross Section
Tank_Cross_Section.description: Cross-Sectional area of the tank in m^2

Tank_GPS_Location_Longitude.label: Tank GPS Location Longitude
Tank_GPS_Location_Longitude.description: GPS Location - Longitude of the device in the format [+/-]12.345678

Tank_GPS_Location_Latitude.label: Tank GPS Location Latitude
Tank_GPS_Location_Latitude.description: GPS Location - Latitude of the device in the format [+/-]12.345678

Minimum_Tank_Discharge_Level.label: Minimum Tank Discharge Level
Minimum_Tank_Discharge_Level.description: Minimum water level that the tank can be discharged to in metres

Valve_State_Validation_Time.label: Valve State Validation Time
Valve_State_Validation_Time.description: The amount of time to wait in seconds before validating the hardware state of the valve if feedback is configured

Tank_Reserve_Pump_Cut-In_Level.label: Tank Reserve Pump Cut-In Level
Tank_Reserve_Pump_Cut-In_Level.description: The water level threshold above which the optional domestic usage pump is enabled if configured as Valve Type 1.

Tank_Reserve_Pump_Cut-Out_Level.label: Tank Reserve Pump Cut-Out Level
Tank_Reserve_Pump_Cut-Out_Level.description: The water level threshold below which the optional domestic usage pump is disabled if configured as Valve Type 1.

Maximum_Discharge_Time.label: Maximum Discharge Time
Maximum_Discharge_Time.description: Maximum expected discharge duration in seconds. Used to limit the duration of any discharge event.

Static_Objects.label: Static Objects
Static_Objects.description: The distances to static objects identified in the tank

Static_Objects_Count.label: Static Objects Count
Static_Objects_Count.description: The number of static objects indentified in the tank

Catchment_Area.label: Catchment Area
Catchment_Area.description: The area of the roof or other surfaces that collects rainwater to be stored in the rainwater tank
